facts.fact: TechnoMag reports the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2026-2030) was officially launched in March 2026.

TechnoMag reports POTRAZ's AI4I Challenge, the implementation framework for the strategy's AI Grand Challenge, offers selected teams up to USD 80,000 in milestone-based grant funding, with 16 winners considered for POTRAZ incubation.
